_comment: Avatar gallery for the Editor's driver-photo picker. Add a PNG (real alpha transparency — not just a checkerboard-patterned background, that won't render transparent) into this folder, then add its filename here so it shows up as a choice. Order here is the order shown in the picker.
_excluded: racer-white-jump.png is still here but left out of this list on purpose: its suit is white, same as the checkerboard's background squares, so automated background removal couldn't tell them apart and mangled it. Re-add it if you get a cleanly-cut version.
